title: BEVFormer: Learning Bird's-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers
grouping: No containers. Three BEV grids stand at the left (queries), bottom-middle (BEV at t-1) and right (BEV at t); a deck of overlapping camera images sits top-middle. Two coloured routes form a parallelogram from the query grid to the output grid: blue through the camera images on top, green through the previous BEV below. A plain-language line runs across the top: 'What's in here at timestamp t ?' -> 'Lookup & Aggregate' -> 'There is a car !', with dotted drop-lines from both ends to the same cell of the input and output grids.
shapes_depth: BEV grids are flat squares of thin grey cells with a light grey frame; the previous and current BEV carry a pale orange road map with small blue vehicle boxes drawn on the grid. The camera views are a fanned deck of greyed photos. The attended region is an outlined ellipse on the camera image (with red sample triangles) and a green-outlined circle on the previous BEV. One query cell is a bold black square; a small red 'Ego' arrow marks the ego position. Thin straight polyline arrows; captions sit under each grid.
proposed_highlight: The method is the two routes themselves: each attention is a coloured path (blue spatial, green temporal) whose label is set in the same colour on the data it reads; no module boxes are drawn.
lesson: Explain a BEV query with a question-and-answer line across the top ('What's in here at timestamp t?' -> 'There is a car!') whose dotted drop-lines pin both ends to the same black-outlined cell of the input and output BEV grids.
notes: Venue ECCV 2022 from the arXiv comment (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref). The refs crop of this Figure 1 also took in the paper's title and author block; the card and its measurements use a copy trimmed at y = 530 px (fig1t.png, with images_px shifted to match), which holds only the figure.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
